AI + Operator Judgment

AI is useful when someone knows how to direct it.

I use Claude Projects and ChatGPT as practical business tools, not as novelty software. My focus is building workflows that help teams move faster: reporting hubs, campaign drafts, structured outputs, attribution tracking, documentation, and repeatable operating systems.

The value is not just prompting. The value is knowing the business problem well enough to guide the tool, catch bad assumptions, validate the data, and redirect the workflow when a technically plausible answer is not actually deployable.

This is especially useful in digital marketing and e-commerce environments where creative, technical, customer, and reporting issues overlap.

Example: AI-assisted operations system

Designed a workflow using Claude Projects, Google Sheets, Make.com, Google Apps Script, campaign IDs, and UTM logic to connect campaign generation, performance tracking, reporting, and future recommendations.

How I Work

Practical systems over noise.

I am strongest in environments where the goal is not just more activity, but better coordination, cleaner execution, and clearer customer paths.

01

Revenue over activity

More campaigns are not better unless they move the right customer behavior. I focus on meaningful conversion events, not busywork.

02

Systems over heroics

If a process requires a heroic save every time, it is not a process. I build repeatable workflows, documentation, and reporting loops.

03

Data with judgment

Dashboards help, but they do not always reveal the issue. I cross-check exports, settlements, campaign logs, and customer behavior when needed.

04

Calm customer experience

Strong operations include human communication. I handle difficult conversations with empathy, clarity, and a solution-focused tone.
